notes: The two determined prepositions are read separately: `בָּעֶרֶב` writes no *the* in *at even*, while `בַּיּוֹם` writes no preposition in *the first day*, so each loses a different morpheme.
Partitive `מִן` → *any of* is headed on the content word *any* under rule 24; heading on *of* was the competing reading.
`יָלִין` holds the whole *shall ... remain all night*, headed on *remain*; heading on *night* is the named alternative.
